title: cytisus scoparius subsp. maurus
intro: Cytisus scoparius subsp. maurus, commonly known as Scotch broom, is a subspecies of shrub that belongs to the Fabaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Scotch broom include stimulating the cardiovascular system, improving digestion, and acting as a mild sedative, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, particularly genistein and isoflavones. The plant's bioactive compounds have been found to have potential in treating various diseases, including cardiovascular and neurological disorders.
